status: prospectively fixed before hard/switching arm training

switching.warm_start: shared D2 weights copied; every mode expert exactly copies each D2 edge update

arms.soft_d2: continuous GNN, soft contact feedback, D2 only
arms.hard_d2: continuous GNN, rounded contact feedback, D2 only
arms.switch_d2: persistent switching-edge GNN, soft contact feedback, D2 only
arms.switch_d3: persistent switching-edge GNN, soft contact feedback, D2 plus D3

primary_metrics: topple and quiet final/initial gap ratios

feasibility_gate.interpretation: a learned switching arm must meet both on 23 DEV topples and 89 DEV quiet states before multi-seed expansion

selection: fixed epoch-3 endpoint; no best-epoch or post-result weight selection
